Taking the time to do your makeup can be a therapeutic and creative process, allowing you to express yourself and enhance your natural features. Blending foundation and perfecting your eyeliner can be a meditative process, requiring focus and attention to detail. It's wonderful that you've developed a skill that brings you a sense of satisfaction and helps you feel put-together. Additionally, having a consistent morning routine can help signal to your brain that it's time to start the day, making it easier to transition into a productive mindset. It's also a great way to practice self-care and prioritize your own well-being. Do you have a favorite part of your makeup routine, or a go-to product that you always reach for?
